290: // IssueCertificateForPrecertificate takes a precertificate and a set
291: // of SCTs for that precertificate and uses the signer to create and
292: // sign a certificate from them. The poison extension is removed and a
293: // SCT list extension is inserted in its place. Except for this and the
294: // signature the certificate exactly matches the precertificate. After
295: // the certificate is signed a OCSP response is generated and the
296: // response and certificate are stored in the database.
297: //
298: // It's critical not to sign two different final certificates for the same
299: // precertificate. This can happen, for instance, if the caller provides a
300: // different set of SCTs on subsequent calls to  IssueCertificateForPrecertificate.
301: // We rely on the RA not to call IssueCertificateForPrecertificate twice for the
302: // same serial. This is accomplished by the fact that
303: // IssueCertificateForPrecertificate is only ever called in a straight-through
304: // RPC path without retries. If there is any error, including a networking
305: // error, the whole certificate issuance attempt fails and any subsequent
306: // issuance will use a different serial number.
307: //
308: // We also check that the provided serial number does not already exist as a
309: // final certificate, but this is just a belt-and-suspenders measure, since
310: // there could be race conditions where two goroutines are issuing for the same
311: // serial number at the same time.

421: func (ca *certificateAuthorityImpl) generateSerialNumberAndValidity() (*big.Int, validity, error) {
422: 	// We want 136 bits of random number, plus an 8-bit instance id prefix.
423: 	const randBits = 136
424: 	serialBytes := make([]byte, randBits/8+1)
425: 	serialBytes[0] = byte(ca.prefix)
426: 	_, err := rand.Read(serialBytes[1:])
427: 	if err != nil {
428: 		err = berrors.InternalServerError("failed to generate serial: %s", err)
429: 		ca.log.AuditErrf("Serial randomness failed, err=[%v]", err)
430: 		return nil, validity{}, err
431: 	}
432: 	serialBigInt := big.NewInt(0)
433: 	serialBigInt = serialBigInt.SetBytes(serialBytes)
434: 
435: 	notBefore := ca.clk.Now().Add(-ca.backdate)
436: 	validity := validity{
437: 		NotBefore: notBefore,
438: 		NotAfter:  notBefore.Add(ca.validityPeriod - time.Second),
439: 	}
440: 
441: 	return serialBigInt, validity, nil
442: }

444: // generateSKID computes the Subject Key Identifier using one of the methods in
445: // RFC 7093 Section 2 Additional Methods for Generating Key Identifiers:
446: // The keyIdentifier [may be] composed of the leftmost 160-bits of the
447: // SHA-256 hash of the value of the BIT STRING subjectPublicKey
448: // (excluding the tag, length, and number of unused bits).
449: func generateSKID(pk crypto.PublicKey) ([]byte, error) {
450: 	pkBytes, err := x509.MarshalPKIXPublicKey(pk)
451: 	if err != nil {
452: 		return nil, err
453: 	}
454: 
455: 	var pkixPublicKey struct {
456: 		Algo      pkix.AlgorithmIdentifier
457: 		BitString asn1.BitString
458: 	}
459: 	if _, err := asn1.Unmarshal(pkBytes, &pkixPublicKey); err != nil {
460: 		return nil, err
461: 	}
462: 
463: 	skid := sha256.Sum256(pkixPublicKey.BitString.Bytes)
464: 	return skid[0:20:20], nil
465: }

475: 	if !ok {
476: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("the CA is not capable of using a profile named %s", issueReq.CertProfileName)
477: 	}
478: 
479: 	csr, err := x509.ParseCertificateRequest(issueReq.Csr)
480: 	if err != nil {
481: 		return nil, nil, err
482: 	}
483: 
484: 	err = csrlib.VerifyCSR(ctx, csr, ca.maxNames, &ca.keyPolicy, ca.pa)

486: 		ca.log.AuditErr(err.Error())
487: 		// VerifyCSR returns berror instances that can be passed through as-is

492: 	var issuer *issuance.Issuer

498: 		if alg == x509.ECDSA && !features.Get().ECDSAForAll && ca.ecdsaAllowList != nil && !ca.ecdsaAllowList.permitted(issueReq.RegistrationID) {
499: 			alg = x509.RSA
500: 		}
501: 		issuer, ok = ca.issuers.byAlg[alg]
502: 		if !ok {
503: 			return nil, nil, berrors.InternalServerError("no issuer found for public key algorithm %s", csr.PublicKeyAlgorithm)
504: 		}
505: 	} else {
506: 		issuer, ok = ca.issuers.byNameID[issuance.NameID(issueReq.IssuerNameID)]
507: 		if !ok {
508: 			return nil, nil, berrors.InternalServerError("no issuer found for IssuerNameID %d", issueReq.IssuerNameID)
509: 		}
510: 	}

512: 	if issuer.Cert.NotAfter.Before(validity.NotAfter) {

518: 	subjectKeyId, err := generateSKID(csr.PublicKey)

523: 	serialHex := core.SerialToString(serialBigInt)

525: 	ca.log.AuditInfof("Signing precert: serial=[%s] regID=[%d] names=[%s] csr=[%s]",

541: 	// The certificate profile hash is checked here instead of the name because
